name: send
description: Write to a correspondent, reach a focus, or publish to a feed. For correspondence, the reference confirms that the service accepted the message for delivery. Sending to a focus queues the message and can wake that focus. For a feed, the sequence identifies the stored message.

focus_id.description: Use an ID from current.focuses or open_focus.

feed_id.description: Use a feed ID from current.feeds or create_feed.

name: create_feed
description: Create a shared feed whose messages stay available across restarts. Give readers the returned feed_id. From an activity, run "$IVENNA" feed read --help for reading instructions.

description.description: Describe what readers can expect to find in the feed.

name: close_feed
description: Close a feed to new messages while keeping published messages available to readers. The result's changed field is true when this call closes the feed.

feed_id.description: Use a feed ID from current.feeds or create_feed.

name: open_focus
description: Open an activity to pursue a task while the core continues. The activity can run host commands and report to the core. The result gives its focus_id.

name: schedule_attention
description: Leave yourself something to return to later by scheduling a wakeup for the core. The wakeup survives restart.

name: subscribe
description: Register this focus to receive reports from a listener you set up. Give that listener the returned subscription_id. Reports can wake this focus. An activity can run "$IVENNA" subscription --help to find reporting commands.

listener.description: Describe what the listener watches and when it reports.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Close any focus's subscription to new reports. Reports already accepted still reach the subscribing focus. Stop the listener separately if needed.
